$description: D&D 5e conditions (SRD 5.2). Status effects that apply to creatures.

data.name: Blinded
data.description: Can't see, fail check needing sight. Attacks vs you Adv, your attacks Dis.

data.name: Charmed
data.description: Can't attack charmer. Charmer has Adv on social checks.

data.name: Deafened
data.description: Can't hear, fail checks needing hearing.

data.name: Exhaustion
data.description: 2024 PHB: Cumulative levels 1–6. Subtract 2 × Exhaustion level from all D20 Tests (Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, Saving Throws, Initiative) and reduce Speed by 5 × level feet. Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 level; level 6 causes Death.

data.name: Frightened
data.description: Dis on checks/attacks while source in sight. Can't move closer.

data.name: Grappled
data.description: 2024 PHB: Speed becomes 0 and cannot increase. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler. The grappler can drag or carry you when moving.

data.name: Incapacitated
data.description: 2024 PHB: You cannot take any Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction. Concentration is immediately broken. You cannot speak, and you have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

data.name: Invisible
data.description: 2024 PHB: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls. You are Concealed unless seen by special senses. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage.

data.name: Paralyzed
data.description: 2024 PHB: Incapacitated (breaks Concentration), Speed 0. Automatically fail STR and DEX saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage and any hit from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit.

data.name: Petrified
data.description: 2024 PHB: Transformed into solid inanimate substance (weight ×10). Incapacitated, Speed 0, fail STR/DEX saves, attacks against you have Advantage, Resistance to all damage, Immunity to Poisoned condition.

data.name: Poisoned
data.description: Dis on attacks and ability checks.

data.name: Prone
data.description: Crawl only. Dis on attacks. Attacks vs you Adv (within 5ft) or Dis (outside).

data.name: Restrained
data.description: 2024 PHB: Speed becomes 0. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, your attack rolls have Disadvantage, and you have Disadvantage on DEX saving throws.

data.name: Stunned
data.description: 2024 PHB: Incapacitated (breaks Concentration), automatically fail STR and DEX saving throws, and attack rolls against you have Advantage.

data.name: Unconscious
data.description: 2024 PHB: Incapacitated (breaks Concentration), Prone, Speed 0, drop held items. Automatically fail STR and DEX saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage and hits from within 5 feet are Critical Hits.

data.name: Raging
data.description: Advantage on STR checks & STR saves, bonus Rage damage (+2/+3/+4) on melee STR attacks, and resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

data.name: Surprised
data.description: 2024 PHB: If a combatant is surprised by combat starting, that combatant has Disadvantage on their Initiative roll.
